title: SRE weekly ops sync — prep + reliability review (2026-03-25)
content:
Purpose: quick prep for weekly SRE ops sync + reliability review. Focus areas: SLO health, paging trends, top incidents, and short-term mitigations + ownership.

Agenda (20-30m):
- Quick wins / wins last week (2-3 min)
- SLO snapshot & error budget burn (5 min)
- Paging trends and oncall load (5 min)
- Top incidents & RCA status (8-10 min)
- Action items / next steps (3-5 min)

SLO snapshot (prod):
- API latency SLO (p50/p95/p99): target 200ms/500ms/1.2s. Current: p50=180ms, p95=510ms (slightly over), p99=1.1s.
- Availability SLO: 99.95% monthly. Current month burn: 0.03% (error budget remaining ~0.02%).
- Embeddings pipeline SLO: success rate target 99.9, current 99.6 (investigate retry/exponential backoff).

Paging trends (last 7 days):
- Total pages: 84 (avg 12/day) - up 40% week-over-week.
- Peak shifts: 02:00-04:00 UTC increased pages tied to nightly batch (batch-job-encoder).
- Top noisy services (by pages): model-gateway (28), kv-cache (17), autoscaler (12).

Top incidents (open / in-progress):
1) INC-2026-310 - regional cache cascade (2026-03-22) 
   - Symptom: sudden latency spike for model-gateway and downstream cache thrash, followed by retries and elevated error rates for 45m.
   - Root cause (prelim): cache eviction storm + aggressive retry policy on client side.
   - Actions: remove aggressive retries (PR merged: PR-789) + patch throttle in autoscaler (in review). Owner: Samira. ETA: 2026-03-26.
2) SRE-145 - nightly embeddings job OOM (2026-03-20)
   - Symptom: nightly embeddings pipeline OOMs at peak memory, causes backpressure to model-serving.
   - Mitigation: reduced concurrency (deployed), long-term: split batch job and add memory-based autoscale. Owner: Ethan. RCA draft linked.

Notes / open questions:
- Do we need a temporary SRE-run throttling rule for overnight batch jobs until autoscaler is more conservative? (quick patch might reduce pages).
- Should we change oncall paging thresholds for model-gateway p95 > 600ms to suppress noisy lower-severity pages?
- Confirm whether embeddings retry storm is client-side or server-side; add tracing for retry headers.

Action items (owner - due):
- Samira: Finish autoscaler throttle PR review + deploy (2026-03-26).
- Ethan: Publish RCA draft for SRE-145 and propose batch-split plan (2026-03-28).
- Aisha: Add temporary rate-limiter on nightly batch queue (config) and measure page impact (2026-03-27).
- Jordan: Update SLO dashboard to include hourly error-budget burn view + alert if burn rate > 2x baseline (2026-03-27).
- Zachary: Add tracing for client retry headers on embeddings pipeline (2026-03-29).

Follow-ups for next sync:
- Check post-deploy metrics for PR-789 and autoscaler changes (Samira).
- Review pages after batch throttle; decide permanent throttling policy (team).
- Finalize SLO alert tuning to reduce noisy pages while keeping high-signal alerts.

Quick links / references:
- Confluence SLO runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SRE/SLO-Runbook
- Incident INC-2026-310 notes (internal): (link to incident doc in ops channel)
- PR-789: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/789
- Nightly batch job: JOB-ID batch-job-encoder

Notes-to-self (short):
- Bring up possibility of dynamic paging thresholds in next reliability discussion.
- Keep one follow-up dedicated to embedding pipeline retries; this has been a recurring theme.

Status: draft - will circularize to collaborators and add any new incidents before meeting.
